description: Answers 'how has this published strategy done since it started?' Give a slug from list_strategies; optionally end (default today). Returns stats, benchmark stats, equity curve, the published spec and the strategy page, re-running the strategy exactly as published on its full point-in-time history. Free on every tier, no API key needed. To change parameters use fork_strategy; to test your own idea use run_backtest (free tier: last 12 months; full history with any purchase).

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

end.description: Last date to run through (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today.

name: run_strategy
title: Re-run a listed strategy
